name: Lust of a Vampire
source:
In the pursuit of eternal companionship, a vampire embarks on a perilous journey, determined to find a bride/s who can fill the void in his immortal heart.

[From [url=https://vespertilio98.itch.io/lust-of-a-vampire]Itch.io[/url]]

为了追求永恒的陪伴，吸血鬼踏上了危险的旅程，决心寻找一位新娘来填补他不朽心中的空虚。
